content: Did a prototype Microsoft gamepad fall off the back of a truck? We can’t say, but a Redditor has legit-looking photos of a prototype Xbox controller that’s almost certainly the Xbox Elite Series 3. Incredibly, they claim they bought the pad for $200 on OfferUp. In May, a Brazilian regulator’s leaked images revealed that Xbox Elite 3 would have new two new scroll wheels on the bottom edge, a second wireless mode to connect directly to Xbox Cloud Gaming servers, and a new “Pair Button” that can also switch between those servers and your console. Where might that pair button live? Today, we have a possible answer: it might sit right next to the Xbox Elite 3’s built-in screen, a previously unrevealed feature. The screen looks almost exactly like the leaked diagram from May showing the mode switch dialogue, with a pair button at the left: [Image: The Anatel image from May, overlaid atop the new prototype controller photos. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/xbox-elite-3-compare.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] And if I’m not mistaken, the screen on Redditor ssuberlex’s controller is displaying the little XCloud rocket ship next to an Xbox Series X. The screen can apparently display other things, too. In another photo, it shows a URL that takes me to a Microsoft cloud resource I don’t have permission to view. That lends these images some extra credibility. Unfortunately, the Redditor says the controller doesn’t work. “It does not pair with an Xbox nor with a cable. Just the red light blinking but doesn’t do any thing wired or wireless,” they wrote. [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/url-xbox-elite-3-screen.webp?quality=90&strip=all] In other photos, we can see the controller’s new scroll wheels, its four rear paddles, its battery compartment, its carrying case, and a different detachable D-pad design than we saw in the May leak. The Redditor says the triggers are clicky when you lock them to the hair-trigger position. [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/anyone-know-what-controller-this-is-is-this-the-elite-v0-vc6hbuprprih1.webp?quality=90&strip=all] [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/anyone-know-what-controller-this-is-is-this-the-elite-v0-svlunrprprih1.webp?quality=90&strip=all] [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/cknyejh8ftih1.jpeg?quality=90&strip=all] [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/aak0o18gftih1.jpeg?quality=90&strip=all] [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/anyone-know-what-controller-this-is-is-this-the-elite-v0-21oluqprprih1.webp?quality=90&strip=all] [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/anyone-know-what-controller-this-is-is-this-the-elite-v0-ak9fwtprprih1.webp?quality=90&strip=all] But beyond the screen, the most intriguing image is from inside the controller’s battery compartment. It appears Microsoft has made efforts to make this controller home repairable by including a QR code that presumably leads to a repair website, and accessible Torx T6 screws. [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/anyone-know-what-controller-this-is-is-this-the-elite-v0-bnvjhythnsih1.webp?quality=90&strip=all] Still, none of these features are for certain. The controller is clearly a prototype, with “NOT FOR SALE” labels on both the pad and its removable 5.8 watt-hour battery, and many placeholder ID numbers for various regulatory bodies. [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/anyone-know-what-controller-this-is-is-this-the-elite-v0-1ygwv8x54tih1.webp?quality=90&strip=all] Tom Warren, The Verge’s Microsoft expert, says his sources believe this controller is still coming later this year.

chineseContent: 微软游戏手柄原型是否从卡车后面掉下来了？我们不能说，但 Reddit 上有一张看起来很合法的 Xbox 原型控制器照片，几乎可以肯定是 Xbox Elite Series 3。令人难以置信的是，他们声称自己在 OfferUp 上花了 200 美元购买了这款手柄。今年 5 月，巴西监管机构泄露的图片显示，Xbox Elite 3 的底部边缘将有两个新的滚轮、直接连接到 Xbox 云游戏服务器的第二种无线模式，以及一个新的“配对按钮”，也可以在这些服务器和主机之间切换。该配对按钮可能位于哪里？今天，我们有了一个可能的答案：它可能位于 Xbox Elite 3 内置屏幕旁边，这是一项之前未公开的功能。屏幕看起来几乎与 5 月份泄露的显示模式切换对话框的图表一模一样，左侧有一个配对按钮： [图片：5 月份的 Anatel 图像，覆盖在新原型控制器照片之上。 https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/xbox-elite-3-compare.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] 如果我没记错的话，Redditor ssuberlex 控制器上的屏幕正在显示 Xbox Series X 旁边的小型 XCloud 火箭飞船。屏幕显然还可以显示其他内容。在另一张照片中，它显示了一个 URL，该 URL 将我带到我无权查看的 Microsoft 云资源。这给这些图像带来了额外的可信度。不幸的是，Reddit 用户表示控制器无法工作。 “它既不与 Xbox 配对，也不与电缆配对。只是红灯闪烁，但不执行任何有线或无线操作，”他们写道。 [图片：https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/url-xbox-elite-3-screen.webp?quality=90&strip=all]在其他照片中，我们可以看到控制器的新滚轮，其四个后拨片
